name: Affinity FCU Pure Rewards Visa

apr.notes: Purchase and balance transfer APR 15.50% to 18.00% per the credit card disclosure dated 12/17/2025; cash advance APR 18.00%.

fx_fee.notes: 2% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

credit_required.notes: Affinity membership required ($5 membership eligibility account).

rewards.redemption_notes: Points never expire and redeem for cash back, travel and other rewards.

signup_bonus.description: 5,000 bonus points on the first purchase, plus 5,000 bonus points for $10,000 in purchases in the first 12 months.

notes: The product page mentions Visa Signature Concierge, but the card is disclosed with the standard Visa cards rather than the Visa Signature disclosure, so network_tier is none.
